messages:
maria-marketing: Quick q — can we ship the OSS ref app tutorial + short demo + webinar next Tues? Need comms plan.
aj-growth: Yes, timeline ok. Who owns the repo README update and tutorial video?
zoe-oss: I'll handle the repo + sample app. Planning a 10-12 min walkthrough video.
devon-eng: I can produce a simple benchmark script and run matrix (cpu/gpu, int8/float16). Will post numbers by EOD Fri.
sam-seo: I'll draft the launch blog + tweet set. Can someone confirm the benchmark narrative — focus latency and $/1k tokens, not raw FLOPs?
devon-eng: Agreed. Show real cost delta with batching and quantization. Example numbers: `g4dn.xlarge` ~ 3.2ms/token vs `a100` 1.1ms/token — roughs.
aj-growth: Routing: inbound signups from webinar should create a lead in HubSpot with tag `oss-refapp-webinar` + UTM params. @maria-marketing can you confirm CRM play?
maria-marketing: Confirmed. Use utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=oss_refapp_q1. Assign to AE pool `oss-inbound` for outreach within 48h.
zoe-oss: For the tutorial README include a minimal quickstart: ```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp.git
cd refapp
pip install -r requirements.txt
./run_demo.sh --model redwood/fast-7b
```
sam-seo: Draft CTA for blog: "Try the ref app — 5-min setup, cost/latency guide, join live demo". Also need a short benchmark table we can screenshot.
devon-eng: I'll export a small CSV and a png chart. Also adding a `bench/README.md` with reproducible commands.
aj-growth: Webinar logistics: 30-min slot, 10-min demo, 10-min benchmarks+Q&A, 10-min product roadmap. Speakers: Zoe (walkthrough), Devon (benchmarks), Maria (product + CTA). Does that work?
maria-marketing: Works. Can we schedule for Tue 11am PST?
calendar-bot: Event scheduled: "OSS RefApp: Live demo + benchmarks" Tue 11:00 PST — Zoom link posted.
sam-seo: I'll prepare promo emails + 3 tweets. Need final date + link by EOD Wed.
zoe-oss: I'll push a PR for the tutorial by tomorrow noon. devon-eng: Bench numbers in PR by Friday.
maria-marketing: Great. Checklist: repo PR, blog draft, tweet copy, webinar create (Zoom), HubSpot form, benchmark PNG, demo script. I'll create a notion checklist and @aj-growth will run the landing page.
aj-growth: On it. Ping me if we need a paid linkedin promo.
maria-marketing: Thanks team :rocket:
